boards.title: Your First Weekend at Massachusetts College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence connecting MCPHS campus resources with nearby Fenway cultural and outdoor stops.

cards.title: Start with the campus calendar
cards.subtitle: Friday: MCPHS student engagement
cards.notes: Open the Cardinal Pride Portal and choose one upcoming club, department, or campus event that fits your first weekend schedule.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for finding MCPHS events, organizations, and resources.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS directs students to the Cardinal Pride Portal for student and department events, clubs, professional organizations, and campus resources.
cards.access_notes: Use MCPHS credentials if the portal requests sign-in.

cards.title: Get oriented over a campus meal
cards.subtitle: Friday: Fennell Hall, 179 Longwood Ave.
cards.notes: Use the first-floor market as a simple meeting point, then stock one practical item for your room before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A campus food market with hot meals and convenience items.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS identifies EAT>Food Market on the first floor of Fennell Hall as offering hand-crafted hot meals and convenience-store items.
cards.access_notes: Food and convenience items require payment or an applicable meal-plan method.

cards.title: Pause in a social campus space
cards.subtitle: Friday: Fennell Building, first floor
cards.notes: Meet a new classmate in the lounge for a short reset; check whether student programming has reserved the room first.
cards.short_summary: A Fennell social space that can also support studying and eating.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS describes Cardinal Lounge as a social area that can be used for studying, socializing, and eating, though it may be unavailable during programming.
cards.access_notes: The space is often used for student programming and may not be available during a program.

cards.title: Take a daylight park walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday: Fenway neighborhood
cards.notes: Follow public paths through the Fens in daylight and pause at the gardens, memorials, or ball fields before returning to campus.
cards.short_summary: An Olmsted-designed park with gardens, memorials, fields, and bird habitat.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston’s Parks Department lists community gardens, the Kelleher Rose Garden, war memorials, ball fields, and bird species among the Back Bay Fens attractions.
cards.access_notes: Use public park paths and follow posted park rules.

cards.title: Reserve an art stop
cards.subtitle: Saturday: 25 Evans Way
cards.notes: Reserve timed entry before walking over, then give yourself time to explore the galleries at an unhurried pace.
cards.short_summary: A nearby museum with timed-entry admissions and college-student pricing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardner Museum lists college-student admission with current ID and recommends advance tickets because entry times can sell out.
cards.access_notes: Advance ticketing is recommended; tickets may not be available at the door.

cards.title: Browse the MFA galleries
cards.subtitle: Saturday: 465 Huntington Ave.
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit around the museum’s posted hours and enter through the Huntington Avenue Entrance with a valid ticket.
cards.short_summary: A Huntington Avenue museum with daily gallery hours and ticketed general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The MFA lists general-admission prices, daily hours, and the Huntington Avenue Entrance for visiting.
cards.source_title: Visit Hours and Admission | Museum of Fine Arts Boston
cards.access_notes: Buy or arrange a valid admission ticket before entry; the museum notes that tickets in advance help ensure availability.

cards.title: Try a free group exercise class
cards.subtitle: Saturday: Wentworth Institute of Technology campus
cards.notes: Bring your MCPHS student identification and check the facility’s current class information before joining a yoga, Pilates, Zumba, or BootCamp session.
cards.short_summary: A nearby fitness center available to MCPHS students.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS states that its students have access to Schumann Fitness Center and that its group exercise classes are open to all students free of charge.
cards.access_notes: MCPHS student access is required; confirm current class scheduling with the fitness center.

cards.title: Set up a library study block
cards.subtitle: Saturday: Matricaria Academic and Student Center, second floor
cards.notes: Choose a seat or quiet-study area, and ask at circulation if you want to reserve one of the library’s group study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 campus library with seating, quiet study, and reservable group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS lists the Henrietta DeBenedictis Library as open 24/7 with seating, group study rooms, study carrels, and a quiet-study space.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms can be booked only when the Circulation Desk is open.

cards.title: Make Sunday quiet study time
cards.subtitle: Sunday: Matricaria Academic and Student Center, third floor
cards.notes: Use an individual carrel for focused reading, or take a tutoring room only when it is not in use for scheduled support.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour quiet study room with individual carrels and tutoring rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS describes Matricaria Quiet Study (3017) as an individual quiet-study space with 40 carrels and three tutoring rooms, open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Tutoring rooms are available for group study only when not in use.

cards.title: Check the next organized outing
cards.subtitle: Sunday: MCPHS Campus Life
cards.notes: Look for an upcoming Campus Life weekend excursion and review the specific registration, transportation, and ticket details before committing.
cards.short_summary: Campus Life offers recurring weekend excursions and seasonal trips.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPHS says students can join weekend excursions and trips, including shopping trips and seasonal experiences such as apple picking.
cards.access_notes: Availability, registration requirements, and any costs depend on the individual trip.
